major_findings: K4 denominator semantics were a post-preregistration pre-inference operationalization and must be described as such.
The exact S1.3.12 anchor model set was not preregistered and was frozen after contamination sensitivity was already known.
Falsification wording must be presented as protocol terminology, not as substantive H2/H4 model-performance evidence.
The protocol Data Dictionary contamination-sign conflict must remain visible as a documented limitation.
Authorship and AI-assistance disclosure must be explicit in the publication candidate.
The final publication manifest must hash publication outputs and record the final freeze commit.

Zenodo metadata requires final live-form mapping, actual publication date, split creator names, explicit related-identifier relations, and DOI reservation before PDF generation if the DOI is printed in the file.
